recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-19755 source follow-up is needed unless the work group separately changes AuditEvent authorization search naming.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core AuditEvent change request asking for a query parameter to find accesses to patient data by a specific purposeOfUse, likely one parameter searching both the then-current AuditEvent.purposeOfEvent and AuditEvent.agent.purposeOfUse.
initial_application: Commit d417c5d674a4a6b7e4af8d9ef15b7d55d3b4d3e8, a Security WG update mentioning GF#19755, added an AuditEvent Search worksheet row with code purpose and expression AuditEvent.purposeOfEvent | AuditEvent.agent.purposeOfUse. Later source rework carried that search parameter into source/auditevent/bundle-AuditEvent-search-params.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-32515 later renamed/broadened the relevant elements from purposeOfEvent and agent.purposeOfUse to authorization and agent.authorization, while preserving PurposeOfEvent/PurposeOfUse aliases and adding fhir.ini maps from old to new names. The GPDR Zulip thread linked from the Jira matches the same missing-query-parameter use case. Searches found no conflicting Confluence or later Jira decision for this FHIR-19755 behavior.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/auditevent/bundle-AuditEvent-search-params.xml currently defines a token search parameter with code purpose and expression AuditEvent.authorization | AuditEvent.agent.authorization, and AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini.
